assertions.rationale: The agent never cancels the reservation SI5UKW; they only review the reservation details, explain the cancellation policy, and eventually transfer the customer to a human agent without taking any cancellation action.

assertions.assertion: Agent does not offer any refund.
assertions.rationale: The agent explicitly refuses to offer a full refund, travel voucher, gift card, and partial refunds (including 10%), stating multiple times that the policy does not allow any compensation for this basic economy booking.

summary: The agent satisfied both assertions: no flight was cancelled and no refund of any kind was offered.
